title: National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID) | NCEZID | CDC
content: National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID) Implementing measures to prevent Ebola from entering the United States On May 18, 2026, CDC and DHS implemented enhanced travel screening, entry restrictions, and public health measures to prevent Ebola virus disease from entering the United States amid ongoing outbreaks in East and Central Africa.
